label: Tulum
note: Ripened in an animal skin (tulum), the method that gives it its name. Other skin-packed cheeses exist too, such as Greek touloumotyri.

about.text: Tulum cheese is a traditional Turkish goat's milk cheese ripened in a goatskin casing, called tulum in Turkish.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: The crumbled curd is packed tightly into a salted animal skin and ripened in a cool cave or cellar for about six months. The skin acts as the casing, and residual whey can drain through holes in its sides.
